query: Do I have to inform ICA if there is a change in passport number due to passport renewal?
reference_answer: The updating of new passport number is not required after the submission of the Pre-Marriage LTVP Assessment (PMLA). However, please take note to update your new passport number in the online application form during your Long-Term Visit Pass (LTVP) application.

answer: Yes, you need to inform Immigration & Checkpoints Authority (ICA) if your passport number changes due to renewal. According to [Document 1], you should apply for a new ABTC under the 'replacement due to change of particulars' category. [Document 2] suggests using the e-Service to report the change. Ensure your new passport details are updated in the MyICA mobile app after receiving it. [Document 3] notes that ICA will validate the passport's validity, so keeping it updated is crucial. [Document 4] confirms that updating passport details in the MyICA app will extend the QR code's validity until the passport expires.
